REASON: NEW_EXACT_SOURCE_LANE

PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE

SOURCE_PRECHECK: The exact remote commit above is authoritative. Verify the commit object and exact HEAD before editing; do not use a stale local checkout, main, or a moving tip as the implementation source.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/work/codex-f71-relay-binding-localization-r1
DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/deliveries/codex-f71-relay-binding-localization-r1
SCOPE: Use only packages/dashboard/components/RelayBindingManager.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RelayBindingManager.test.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/relay/page.tsx, packages/core/src/locale.ts, packages/core/src/locale-catalogs.ts, and narrowly related relay catalog tests under packages/core/src.
MISSION: Close the verified F-89/F-71 relay operator-surface localization gap. RelayBindingManager still emits hardcoded English guidance, empty/error/status/action copy, confirmation text, form labels, channel reference placeholder and retry text even though its parent route already resolves the selected locale. Localize the component through the existing typed catalog without changing relay binding API calls, idempotency, role policy, model scope, retry semantics, channel values, or RelayCardHistory behavior.
PASS_CRITERIA: 1. Resolve SOURCE_REF exactly, create COPY_ROOT from that commit, and prove the source HEAD before editing. 2. Make real source changes only inside COPY_ROOT; a copied baseline, docs-only claim, generated output, or helper-only change is not delivery. 3. Pass the existing parent translator into RelayBindingManager and localize its fixed guidance, no-destination state, table headings, enabled/disabled values, confirmation prompt, add-destination form, role restriction, validation/error/success/retry messages and accessible labels across en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de. Channel identifiers, chat references and provider data remain data and must not be translated. 4. Preserve the existing POST/PATCH paths, request bodies, idempotency-key behavior, response confirmation, retry-same-intent behavior, canEdit gate, modelId binding, window.confirm semantics and channel list. Do not add a schema, migration, provider call or alternate relay model. 5. Add focused behavior tests for the real parent/component callsite, owner/editor and read-only role rendering, empty and populated rows, enabled/disabled labels, validation/error/success/retry copy, confirmation text and representative output for all six locales. Add or update catalog completeness coverage for every new key. 6. Run the focused dashboard tests, owning core catalog tests, dashboard typecheck and dashboard lint; record exact commands and real exit codes. 7. DELIVERY must list the exact source HEAD, COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT, changed paths, independently reproducible SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names and counts, typecheck/lint results, changed-file summary, LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE and explicit confirmation that no deployment, installer, migration, database, provider, OAuth, credential, permission, systemd, network or runtime action occurred.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: Reuse existing relay keys where sufficient. If a new key is required, add only feature-owned keys to all six catalogs with focused completeness coverage. One Codex audit only; if the contract or source cannot satisfy a criterion without an unapproved schema/provider/runtime change, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact conflict instead of inventing one.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth calls, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output outside COPY_ROOT, or files outside the named scope. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified DELIVERY, runs owning checks, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery.
sincerely, Codex
